finalists.label: Adrenal Cortical Carcinoma
finalists.why: The presence of a 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass containing regions of necrosis, with local extension into and invasion of the pancreatic tail, left hemidiaphragm, and spleen, along with the presence of multiple enlarged regional lymph nodes, strongly supports this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Adrenal gland neoplasm
finalists.why: The presence of a 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass containing regions of necrosis, with local extension into and invasion of the pancreatic tail, left hemidiaphragm, and spleen, along with the presence of multiple enlarged regional lymph nodes, is a strong evidence for this diagnosis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it is a more specific diagnosis that accounts for the presence of the adrenal mass and its local extension, whereas the runner-up is a more general term that only accounts for the presence of the adrenal mass.
